source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / Munsif Daily / Times of India
bullets_en: Heavy overnight rain inundates low-lying colonies, disrupts traffic across Hyderabad.
KNRUHS opens second-phase web options for PG medical admissions under Management Quota.
Coffee planter killed in wild elephant attack in Kodagu.
Israeli strikes kill 10 in Gaza as tensions escalate across Middle East.
Terror attack on IAF station foiled: Gujarat ATS arrests JeM operative, rifle recovered.
bullets_ur: Raat bhar ki tez barish se Hyderabad ki nichhi bastiyan doob gayeen, traffic mutasir.
KNRUHS ne Management Quota ke tehat PG medical admissions ke liye doosre marhalay ke web options khol diye.
Kodagu mein jangli hathi ke hamlay mein coffee ka kisan halaq ho gaya.
Middle East mein barhti kashadgi ke darmiyan Israeli hamlon mein Gaza mein 10 log jaan se gaye.
IAF station par dehshatgardi ka hamla nakaam: Gujarat ATS ne JeM operative ko giraftar kar ke rifle baramad kar li.
